items.headline: Replit makes OpenAI its default AI partner, reduces reliance on Anthropic
items.body: Replit CEO Amjad Masad announced that OpenAI's ChatGPT is now the default model for Replit's AI coding platform, replacing Anthropic's Claude models due to performance, cost, and partnership considerations. While Anthropic models remain available, most users are expected to use the default, likely reducing Replit's spend with Anthropic. Masad also noted a shift in Replit's revenue toward enterprise and government customers, and emphasized the importance of robust AI safety measures. Some insiders dispute the extent of the partnership change, but Replit confirms OpenAI is now preferred.

items.headline: Anthropic commits 5% of shares to new public benefit fund
items.body: Anthropic announced it will allocate 5% of its shares to a newly created public benefit fund aimed at supporting projects for societal good, with the option to increase this by 2% for every 50% rise in company value. The fund may make large donations to nonprofits or direct distributions, and Anthropic plans to share more details on its governance in coming months.

items.headline: Laplace Intelligence develops AI-driven red-teaming for robotics and autonomous vehicles
items.body: Laplace Intelligence, a startup from Ann Arbor, is building automated red-teaming tools that use AI to stress-test robotics and physical AI systems in high-fidelity simulations before real-world deployment. The company’s platform reconstructs real environments and uses AI agents to probe for weaknesses, aiming to improve safety for robots, autonomous vehicles, and smart city solutions. Laplace is working with customers in autonomous trucking, automotive manufacturing, and smart city pilots.
